note: Severity P0 items were reproduced against the running instance before any code was changed; see repro-log.txt. Verification results are measured (DOM/route/overflow), not visual judgements. No pixel comparison against a reference image was performed.

findings.referenceDifference: Typing the leaderboard URL returned the 404 page instead of the leaderboard.
findings.rootCause: No /leaderboard route existed. The page lived only at /rankings, and the header linked /rankings, so every existing E2E reached it by click and never exercised direct entry.
findings.verificationResult: PASS - direct entry renders the leaderboard; /rankings?period=week redirects to /leaderboard?period=week; header href is /leaderboard. p0-verify-log.txt + e2e/phase-ui-round4-routing.e2e.ts

findings.referenceDifference: TanStack Router Devtools panel visible bottom-right in review screenshots.
findings.rootCause: Mounted for the whole of MODE === 'development' in __root.tsx. Never present in the production bundle, but rsbuild.config.ts binds port 4173 for both `dev` and `preview`, so the agreed acceptance URL could be serving either build.
findings.verificationResult: PASS - routerDT=false on all 56 route/viewport combinations; asserted by 'public pages carry no devtools overlays'.

findings.referenceDifference: Coloured circular floating icon bottom-left, suspected browser extension.
findings.rootCause: It is ours, not an extension: ReactQueryDevtools with buttonPosition='bottom-left', mounted by the same condition as R4-02.
findings.verificationResult: PASS - queryDT=false on all 56 combinations. Detected structurally via .tsqd-parent-container rather than by eye.

findings.referenceDifference: Site read as a green product; reference is white with a blue-cyan wash, small violet accent and near-black CTA.
findings.rootCause: Every neutral token carried the brand hue 165 - background, surface, foreground, border, muted - and --primary was green, so green was the page surface rather than the brand mark.
findings.verificationResult: PARTIAL - measurable parts pass: background is now oklch(1 0 0), --primary is near-black, ambient-field and text-gradient-brand use blue/violet, dark mode is tuned separately and reports dark=true on 16/16 dark rows. Whether it now resembles the reference is a visual judgement not made here.

findings.referenceDifference: Typography and metrics undersized; page sparse at 1920.
findings.rootCause: type-hero capped at 3.5rem, type-section-title at 2.25rem, metric values at text-4xl, and --container-content at 76rem left ~350px of gutter per side at 1920.
findings.verificationResult: PASS (measured) - hero clamp now 2.25-4.1rem, section title 1.65-2.75rem, container 84rem, metric values text-4xl/5xl/6xl with column rules. No horizontal overflow at any of the seven widths.

findings.referenceDifference: Page titled '模型'; two cards hugged the left with the right third of the page empty.
findings.rootCause: Fixed 2xl:grid-cols-3 grid regardless of result count, and a heading that did not name the product surface.
findings.verificationResult: PASS - heading is now 'Model Square' / 模型广场; the third column only engages at >= 3 results, otherwise the grid is capped at max-w-5xl so two cards fill their row. No placeholder card invented.

findings.referenceDifference: Large dead band between header and title.
findings.rootCause: pt-24/sm:pt-28 on a page whose content is short because only two models exist.
findings.verificationResult: PASS (measured) - page height fell from 1146 to 1114 with the masthead moved up; provisional banner and pricing API semantics untouched.

findings.referenceDifference: Section eyebrows would have flattened to the same colour as their headings once --primary became near-black.
findings.rootCause: Nine call sites used 'type-label text-primary' for the accent role.
findings.verificationResult: PASS - new text-brand-accent utility resolves to --brand-blue; zero remaining 'type-label text-primary' occurrences.

findings.referenceDifference: English UI said 'Rankings' while the route said /leaderboard and Chinese said 排行榜.
findings.rootCause: Vocabulary split between route, nav label and heading - the same drift that let /leaderboard 404 unnoticed.
findings.verificationResult: PASS - en value for the 'Rankings' key is now 'Leaderboard'; zh unchanged at 排行榜.

findings.referenceDifference: Not a visual finding - surfaced while running the suite against a production build.
findings.rootCause: main.tsx retries queries until failureCount > 3 in PROD but never retries in DEV. The catalog error-state test allowed the default 5s, which is shorter than four attempts plus exponential backoff, so it passed against a dev server and failed against a production bundle.
findings.verificationResult: PASS - assertion timeout sized to the documented retry chain. The retry policy itself was not weakened.

openGaps: No pixel-level comparison was performed. No reference screenshot is stored in this repository and no image-diff tool was run.
Leaderboard, pricing and catalogue density remain below the reference because the deployment has two models and two days of data. No series, card or figure was fabricated to fill them.
Sign-in/sign-up left narrative column is still sparse at 768-1024; only the colour system and shared shell changed this round.

Two authenticated suites (phase5c-subscriptions, phase4-7-i18n zhCN) fail intermittently under full-suite ordering and pass in isolation. Pre-existing shared-backend-state flakiness, unrelated to the public pages changed here.
